name: Basic Melee Attack
description: Single-target close-range attack with cooldown and damage falloff by range. Reach and the damage it requests are ITS numbers, so it is where a character's melee bonuses are applied: it reads progression.skills_tree's `bonuses` for `meleeDamage` and `meleeRange` and adds them to its own declared inputs. The skill tree does not reach in and change them, and combat.damage_resolver still owns mitigation and variance — the request grows, the resolution does not move.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
